ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; the surface is predominantly low-intensity black (approx. 90-95%) with high-intensity white signals limited to surface abrasions and scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity dark field across the visible area, interspersed with high-contrast white linear streaks and circular clusters concentrated in the medial and distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 72 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, high-frequency irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations (jaggedness) ranging from 5 to 20 pixels relative to the water interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trailing edge curve tapering toward narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white high-contrast clusters scattered across the dark surface, particularly visible as small white rings or dots on the mid-left and lower-right regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations across the entire visible fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent textured biological encrustations (barnacle colonies) present on the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular 'O' shaped white scar on the mid-left lobe and distinct parallel horizontal rake marks on the lower right lobe.
